desc: Parse N and S from stdin, find all positions of '1', and count the number of ones K.
Derive the transformed-position formula a_j = pj - j + 1 that turns the grouping cost into a sum of absolute deviations from a block start L.
Identify the optimal block start as the median of the transformed positions and compute the corresponding minimum swap count (K=1 handled naturally).
Implement the complete Python solution reading stdin and writing only the final answer to stdout.
Verify against sample cases (7/0101001 -> 3, 3/100 -> 0, 10/0101001001 -> 7) and edge cases: single one, already contiguous, alternating, and N=5e5 worst case for performance.
Run the code on the provided samples to confirm the SAMPLE TESTS verdict before marking done.
